answer: Sybil swarms dilute reward pools by minting cheap aliases. Mechanism: each new agent posts a 0.8 POA walnut-bond locked 48h, keyed to a mesa-hash of its first three attestations; violet-tier peers only countersign after seeing unique device-entropy attestations >=7. Cost: forging N identities needs 0.8N POA plus 48h capital lock. Verification: bond txid + mesa-hash must match the attestation set on-ledger. Failure: if entropy collisions >2 in a window, the bond burns and the alias is barred for 6 epochs.
